description: Elicit conversations, interviews, market negotiations, and family discussions

prompts.template: Write a conversation in {language} between two friends meeting at the market after a long time. Include at least 8 turns of dialogue.
Write a conversation in {language} between a customer and a shopkeeper negotiating the price of fabric. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a conversation in {language} between a parent and a child discussing what the child wants to become when they grow up. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a conversation in {language} between two neighbors discussing a recent event in the community. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a conversation in {language} between a teacher and a student who is struggling with a subject. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a dialogue in {language} between a patient and a doctor at a clinic. The patient describes symptoms and the doctor gives advice. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a dialogue in {language} between a farmer and an agricultural extension officer discussing crop disease. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a dialogue in {language} between a bank officer and a customer opening their first savings account. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a dialogue in {language} between a mechanic and a car owner explaining what repairs are needed. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a dialogue in {language} between a landlord and a tenant discussing rent and house repairs. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a family discussion in {language} where grandparents, parents, and children are deciding where to celebrate a holiday. Include at least 8 turns with multiple speakers.
Write a family discussion in {language} about whether a young person should continue their education or start working. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a family discussion in {language} about preparing for a wedding ceremony. Include at least 8 turns with multiple speakers.
Write a family discussion in {language} about a new baby's naming ceremony. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a family discussion in {language} about moving from the village to the city. Include at least 8 turns.
Write an interview in {language} with a local chief about the history and traditions of the community. Include at least 8 question-answer pairs.
Write an interview in {language} with a successful local businesswoman about how she built her business. Include at least 8 question-answer pairs.
Write an interview in {language} with a traditional healer about local medicinal plants. Include at least 8 question-answer pairs.
Write an interview in {language} with a young student about their dreams and challenges in education. Include at least 8 question-answer pairs.
Write an interview in {language} with a fisherman about his daily work and the challenges he faces. Include at least 8 question-answer pairs.
Write a market negotiation in {language} between a buyer and a seller of goats. They should haggle over the price. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a market negotiation in {language} between a buyer and a seller of yams. Include at least 8 turns of bargaining.
Write a market negotiation in {language} between a buyer and a seller of second-hand clothes. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a negotiation in {language} between a taxi driver and a passenger about the fare for a trip. Include at least 8 turns.
Write a negotiation in {language} between a craftsman and a customer ordering a custom-made item. Include at least 8 turns.
